ambient_events: Something long-cooked ticks over in the big pot; whoever is on galley duty lifts the lid, sniffs, and puts it back.
A chalked rota on the wall runs three weeks out, every name accounted for.
Onions and bunched herbs hang from a length of salvaged conduit.
description: A working kitchen, hot and cramped and smelling of onions and scorched iron. Nothing here came out of a vendor packet, because a hundred ration purchases a week is a shape the Architect can see from orbit, so the Watch cook. Sacks of dried goods are stacked to the ceiling, labelled by hand, and a pot that has clearly never been empty sits over a low flame.
name: The Galley
